decisive_items: weak clonal band in a polyclonal background
Repeat molecular studies showed no evidence of clonal rearrangement
response.rationale: HSV-2 history and absent clonal rearrangement favor reactive pseudolymphoma over MF; epidermotropism on second biopsy is less specific. LyP lacks CD30+ and typical self-healing papules.

rejected.why: Lacks persistent clonal TCR rearrangement, essential for MF; epidermotropism alone insufficient.
No CD30+ large cells or self-healing papules; clinical and histology more consistent with pseudolymphoma.
